selection: Coaches evaluate hitting, fielding, throwing and running at each station. How and when families hear back will be posted before tryouts.

faq.a: The season fee is posted here with tryout details each year.

faq.q: How much time does it take?
faq.a: Games are on Sundays. Each team's coach sets the practice schedule and shares it before the season starts.
Some travel should be expected for tournaments. The Tridents are not a true travel team, by design: we play within PONY's rules and scope.
Uniform details and ordering come with your team's welcome email.

faq.q: Can my player still play rec ball?
faq.a: Yes. The Tridents play on Sundays so players can stay with their Great Neck rec team. Rec is the foundation, not something to leave behind.

faq.q: How does it fit with All-Stars?
faq.a: Players can do both. Talk with your team's coordinator about the spring schedule.
